basis: Rite Aid’s fiscal 2024 first-quarter earnings release was the earliest qualifying communication found. Its consolidated GAAP statements report revenue of $5,653,162,000 for the 13 weeks ended June 3, 2023, versus $6,014,583,000 for the 13 weeks ended May 28, 2022. Revenue fell 6.01% and was $60,691,850 below the $5,713,853,850 threshold. Both figures include Elixir. Rite Aid attributed the decline largely to lower prescription drug plan membership and lost commercial clients at Elixir, partly offset by retail pharmacy growth.

coverage.detail: December 21, 2022, preceding earnings cycle. The fiscal 2023 third-quarter release forecast $23.7 billion to $24.0 billion for all of fiscal 2023. Any fourth quarter implied by subtracting nine-month actuals would be fiscal 2023 Q4, one quarter before the target.

On the December 21 call, CEO Heyward Donigan said it was too early to issue guidance for fiscal 2024. Management discussed expected Elixir membership losses without quantifying fiscal 2024 Q1 consolidated revenue.
January 9, 2023. The CEO-transition announcement reaffirmed the $23.7 billion to $24.0 billion fiscal 2023 annual revenue range.

April 20, previous quarterly release. Rite Aid reported fiscal 2023 Q4 and forecast fiscal 2024 total revenue of $21.7 billion to $22.1 billion. The annual high end implied an average of $5.525 billion per quarter, but left Q1 revenue individually unbounded.
The April 20 investor presentation labels the $21.7 billion to $22.1 billion range FY2024 guidance. Its guidance table gives no Q1 consolidated revenue range.

On the April 20 call, an analyst explicitly asked about Q1. CFO Matt Schroeder discussed first-half investments and the timing of EBITDA. He also clarified that $10 million of turnaround benefits related to the completed fourth quarter. Neither answer supplied a Q1 revenue figure.
The intervening May 2 Form 8-K disclosed a $1.5 million CFO retention award under Item 5.02 and contained no sales update.

June 12, after quarter end. Rite Aid’s own wire notice scheduled the June 29 results and analyst call without reporting preliminary revenue. Searches for interim guidance, investor presentations and public management remarks through June 28 found no earlier qualifying figure.
June 29 actuals. The consolidated statements of operations give the revenue row in thousands as 5,653,162 and 6,014,583. These figures provide greater precision than the release headline.

publication_date_evidence: Rite Aid marked Exhibit 99.1 for immediate release, dated it June 29, 2023, in Philadelphia, and stated that it was reporting results that day for the first fiscal quarter ended June 3. Its June 12 issuer notice independently identified June 29 as the scheduled public release date.
